archives.name: ICOS Carbon Portal
archives.notes: All ICOS data products under the ICOS CC BY 4.0 licence. Metadata (SPARQL, station and object landing pages, meta.json) is public; a data-object download redirects to https://data.icos-cp.eu/licence until the licence is accepted. Python access: icoscp (PyPI).

archives.name: DEIMS-SDR site and dataset registry
archives.notes: OpenAPI 3.0 description at /api (DEIMS API 1.1): /sites, /sites/{id}, /activities, /activities/{id}, /sensors, /sensors/{id}, /locations/{id}. Metadata licence CC BY-NC 4.0 (from the OpenAPI document).

archives.name: eLTER Digital Asset Register
archives.notes: InvenioRDM-style REST API: /api/records and /api/external-datasets return JSON hits with self and self_html links.

archives.name: TERN Data Access Platform (THREDDS / OPeNDAP)
archives.notes: THREDDS catalogs with OpenDAP, DAP4, NetCDF Subset and HTTP file services; OzFlux flux-tower netCDF under ecosystem_process/ozflux/. Licence CC BY 4.0 as the OzFlux files state it (license attribute).

archives.name: TERN Data Discovery Portal and CSW catalogue
archives.notes: OGC CSW 2.0.2 (XML) catalogue behind the TERN Data Discovery Portal; TERN Linked Data at https://linkeddata.tern.org.au/. TERN accounts: https://account.tern.org.au/.

archives.name: OzFlux data portal
archives.notes: Named as data_link in every OzFlux L3 netCDF; the files themselves are served by tern-dap.

archives.name: SAEON Open Data Platform
archives.notes: ODP API 2.4: every /catalog route requires OAuth2 client credentials (scopes odp.catalog:read / odp.catalog:search) except /catalog/{catalog_id}/go/{doi}, a public redirect to the record landing page. The catalogue web UI is public.

archives.name: CNERN science and technology resource service (国家生态系统观测研究网络科技资源服务系统)
archives.organization: Chinese National Ecosystem Research Network (CNERN) / CERN
archives.notes: Station data resources (台站数据资源) and data-resource search at /data/initDRsearch; user registration at http://passport2.cern.ac.cn/reg and login through passport2.cern.ac.cn.

archives.name: DataCite REST API
archives.notes: DOI registry; SAEON registers every Observations Monitor station under prefix 10.15493 (fetch_saeon_stations.py reads it).

archives.name: GERI collection, CyVerse Data Store
archives.organization: CyVerse (University of Arizona) for the GERI AccelNet project
archives.notes: iRODS path /iplant/home/shared/geri; anonymous WebDAV read at the base URL; iRODS (gocmd) with a CyVerse account for writes and metadata. Holds source data by research infrastructure, intermediate outputs and the harmonized drought datasets. Licence CC0 per the collection DataCite record (datacite.rights.1.value).

archives.name: GERI data portal (DataONE)
archives.organization: DataONE for the GERI AccelNet project
archives.notes: Where the Data Store README says the harmonized datasets are published and discoverable; searchable through the DataONE coordinating-node Solr API.

archives.name: TERN AusPlots API
archives.notes: PostgREST service over TERN's Ecosystem Surveillance (AusPlots) plots: sites and visits (/site), vegetation point-intercept (/veg_pi), basal area, vouchers, soils. No key needed; the root returns an OpenAPI description. The ausplotsR R package reads it. Plain http only (https does not answer).

archives.name: AmeriFlux
archives.organization: AmeriFlux Management Project (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory)
archives.notes: Flux-tower registry and data for the Americas; 14 MexFlux towers are registered here. The site list (site_display API) and site pages are public. Per the data policy, most sites share data under CC BY 4.0 (the rest under the Legacy policy), and the download portal asks each user how they plan to use the data, which is sent to the site PIs; whether that needs an account was not checked.

archive_overrides.notes: NEON publishes ~180 standardized data products (DPID DP[1-4].YYYYY.NNN) across 81 field sites in 20 domains; annual RELEASE-YYYY tags are citable. Catalog calls (/products, /sites, /locations, /releases, /taxonomy) are public; data calls (/data/...) return 403 without a NEON API token (X-API-Token), checked 2026-10-25. File URLs in /data responses are pre-signed and time-limited. (lto recorded AOP rasters in s3://neon-aop-products; that S3 bucket does not exist, checked 2026-10-25.)
